# Downloaded Benchmark Data

Store public or benchmark datasets used to test robustness and external validity.

## Purpose

- Compare with established baselines.
- Test across easy, hard, clean, and messy datasets.
- Identify assumptions that held only for synthetic data.

## Inventory and Provenance

| Filename or Pattern | Source URL/DOI | Version or Retrieval Date | Checksum | License/Terms | Used By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | |

Record retrieval commands, preprocessing, exclusions, and access conditions. Data files are
ignored by default; this tracked inventory must make acquisition and transformation reproducible.
